description: Lightweight invoice/payment dispute truth pack for approval authority, invoice timing, and conditional payment regressions.

documents.name: Invoice 4481
documents.text: 2024-05-01 Ridgeway Components issued Invoice 4481 to Solace Retail for the North Pier fixture shipment with net 30 payment terms.

documents.name: Approval Email
documents.text: 2024-05-06 Finance director Priya Nair approved payment for Invoice 4481 subject to receiving signed delivery confirmation.

documents.name: Delivery Confirmation
documents.text: 2024-05-09 The warehouse record showed the North Pier fixture delivery was signed by Solace receiving clerk Jonah Mills.

documents.name: Payment Hold Notice
documents.text: 2024-05-20 Solace Retail placed Invoice 4481 on hold, claiming payment authority was never final because the delivery confirmation was disputed.

known_contradictions.claim_a: Priya Nair approved payment for Invoice 4481.
known_contradictions.claim_b: Solace Retail claimed payment authority was never final.

ambiguities.notes: The delivery confirmation is signed, but the payment hold notice says the confirmation was disputed.

golden_questions.question: Was payment approval final or conditional?
Why did Solace place Invoice 4481 on hold?

memo_topics.issue: Whether Solace had final payment approval authority for Invoice 4481
